title: An experiment finds X's feed algorithm favored conservative content, and switching to the "For you" feed shifted users' views toward more conservative positions (Ece Yildirim/Gizmodo)
summary: Ece Yildirim / Gizmodo: An experiment finds X's feed algorithm favored conservative content, and switching to the “For you” feed shifted users' views toward more conservative positions — The algorithm also doesn't like posts by traditional news media, the researchers found.
